name: Trim Interstage (Between Coats)
intent: Inspect the cured first finish coat, sand between coats, patch any defects revealed by the first coat, spot-coat patches, clean dust before the second coat. Trim ALWAYS gets sanded between coats regardless of QT (different from drywall where interstage is QT4+ only) because trim takes a high-gloss finish that magnifies any surface texture.
doctrine: Trim interstage is mandatory for ALL quality tiers because residential trim takes a satin/semigloss/gloss sheen that reveals every surface defect. This is meaningfully different from drywall where interstage only fires for QT4/QT5 — drywall walls take eggshell/flat which hides surface texture. Most rates here are gap-filled estimates flagged in individual tasks. V1a: pass_group_id: [null] gate skips these when the trim substrate is a finish_group_assignment member — MOD_INTERSTAGE_FINISH_GROUP handles the dedup-level interstage.
